title: 10 Best Catharanthus Roseus Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Catharanthus roseus are tinctures, creams, capsules, ointments, and decoctions, each offering unique benefits for various health conditions. Tinctures provide concentrated extracts for internal use, while creams and ointments are applied topically to treat skin ailments. Capsules offer a convenient oral dosage form, and decoctions are prepared by boiling the plant parts to extract their active compounds. These preparations are valued for their potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer properties. Traditional and modern medicine alike continue to explore their therapeutic applications.
